Complete DevOps & Cloud Engineering Course with AI Tools

Live Course
196k+ interested Geeks

The DevOps & Cloud Engineering course is a 16-week live, mentor-led programme covering Linux, shell scripting, Python automation, Git, CI/CD with Jenkins and GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes on AWS, Terraform, Ansible, and monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana. It starts from Linux and Python fundamentals, so no prior DevOps experience is assumed. You build ten portfolio projects, ending with a production-grade cloud architecture capstone, and earn an IBM & GeeksforGeeks certificate.

Course Syllabus

Complete DevOps & Cloud Engineering Course with AI Tools
AI Toolkit for Developers

Session 1: Linux Fundamentals I

  • Linux file system, kernel & shell, and the FHS
  • Permissions model (rwx, octal, chmod/chown)
  • Process management (ps, top, signals, fg/bg)
  • Pipes & redirection basics

Session 2: Linux Fundamentals II - Power User

  • Text processing: grep, sed, awk one-liners
  • Finding things: find, locate, which
  • Users, groups & sudo; packages (apt/dnf)
  • Services with systemd; disk & memory tools

Session 3: Shell Scripting I

  • Shebang, variables & quoting rules
  • Conditionals: if / case, test operators
  • Loops: for, while read, until
  • Functions, arguments & exit codes

Session 4: Shell Scripting II - Filesystems & Performance

  • Defensive scripting (set -euo pipefail, trap, validation)
  • Logging & debugging (log(), bash -x, shellcheck)
  • Monitoring scripts for CPU, memory & disk with alerting
  • Scheduling with cron & filesystem automation

Project: System Health Monitor - filesystem automation + performance reporting (portfolio project)

Read more

1: The AI Toolkit & Developer Setup

  • Map of AI tools: LLMs, code assistants, AI search, agents
  • Tool categories: chat models, IDE copilots, CLI agents
  • Evaluation framework: accuracy, context window, cost, latency
  • When AI helps vs. when it hurts: real limitations
  • Setting up an AI-powered dev environment in 30 minutes
  • Live experiment: solving the same problem with multiple tools

2: Prompt Engineering & Vibe Coding

  • Vibe coding: natural language to code (fast prototyping)
  • Anatomy of a developer prompt: role, context, task, constraints
  • Zero-shot to few-shot escalation strategy
  • Chain-of-thought prompting for better reasoning
  • Iterative prompting and fixing hallucinations

3: Spec-Driven Development with AI

  • Transition from prompts to structured specifications
  • Writing clear technical specs before code generation
  • Few-shot prompting with real codebase patterns
  • Generating reliable code aligned with requirements
  • Reducing ambiguity and improving determinism

4: RAG Systems & Context-Aware AI

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) fundamentals
  • Embeddings, vector databases, semantic search
  • Connecting AI to codebases, docs, and internal data
  • Building developer assistants using RAG
  • Limitations and failure modes of RAG systems
